description: Redesign Auth.tsx into a multi-step X/Twitter-style authentication flow with Landing, Email, Phone, and Username login screens. Add Firebase Phone Auth support.
steps: Replace the current src/pages/Auth.tsx with a multi-step flow using React state to track the current step: 'landing' | 'email' | 'phone' | 'username'

Landing step: Parallax logo centered (serif italic), tagline 'See what's happening', Google + Email icon buttons at bottom with 'or' divider, 'Continue with Phone' full-width button, terms text at bottom, 'Login with username >' link at very bottom. Pure black bg, white text, spacious layout.

Email step: Back arrow left, 'Use phone' top-right, bold 'Enter your email address' title, 'We'll send you a verification code' subtitle, email input field, 'Continue' button at bottom, privacy text. On continue, proceed to password step or inline password entry.

Phone step: Back arrow left, 'Use email' top-right, bold 'Enter your phone number' title, country flag picker (show India flag + +91 default), phone number input, 'Continue' button, privacy text. Integrate Firebase Phone Auth using RecaptchaVerifier and signInWithPhoneNumber from firebase/auth.

Username login step: Back arrow left, 'Forgot username' top-right, bold 'Enter your username' title, '@ username' input, 'Continue' button, then alternative auth options: 'Continue with Google' / 'Continue with Email' / 'Continue with Phone' buttons with icons.

Keep all existing auth logic (handleAuth, handleGoogle, writeProfile, routeForUser, inProgress ref pattern). Add new handlePhoneAuth logic using firebase signInWithPhoneNumber. Add OTP verification step after phone number submission.
Ensure all screens have: pure black background, white text, minimal spacing, framer-motion transitions between steps using AnimatePresence.
acceptance_criteria: Auth.tsx renders a multi-step flow starting with a landing screen
Landing shows Parallax logo, tagline, Google button, Email button, Phone button, and username login link
Email step has back navigation, 'Use phone' switch, email input, and Continue button
Phone step has back navigation, 'Use email' switch, country code display, phone input, and Continue button
Username step has back navigation, username input, Continue button, and alternative auth methods
Firebase Phone Auth is integrated with RecaptchaVerifier and signInWithPhoneNumber
Existing email/password auth and Google auth continue to work
All steps use pure black background with white text
TypeScript compiles without errors (NODE_OPTIONS= npx tsc --noEmit)
verification: NODE_OPTIONS= npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
findings: TypeScript compiles cleanly with zero errors. Removed the old tab-based signup/signin UI in favor of multi-step flow. The supabase import and sync logic is preserved. The old AccountKind/organization selector was removed since the multi-step flow focuses on sign-in/sign-up through email, phone, or username lookup. The email flow now tries signIn first, and if user-not-found it auto-creates an account. Phone auth uses invisible RecaptchaVerifier.
